hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ..)"; if [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/pre-tool-guard.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/hooks/pre-tool-guard.sh"; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/dev/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/dev/agy-hook.sh" pre-tool; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" PreToolUse; elif [ -x "$root/bin/agy-hook-eval" ]; then exec "$root/bin/agy-hook-eval"; else echo "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"; fi'

bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ..)"; if [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/post-tool-audit.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/hooks/post-tool-audit.sh"; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/dev/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/dev/agy-hook.sh" post-tool; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" PostToolUse; else echo "{}"; fi'

PreInvocation.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ..)"; if [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/pre-invocation.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/hooks/pre-invocation.sh"; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" PreInvocation; else echo "{\"injectSteps\":[]}"; fi'

PostInvocation.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ..)"; if [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/post-invocation.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/hooks/post-invocation.sh"; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" PostInvocation; else echo "{\"injectSteps\":[]}"; fi'

Stop.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ..)"; if [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/stop-guard.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/hooks/stop-guard.sh"; elif [ -x "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" ]; then exec "$root/scripts/agy-hook.sh" Stop; else echo "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"; fi'
